svg.title: Where the new version stands, per question
svg.desc: The new version's cost against 0.1.5 and against main + six fixes, per question, as a factor: 1 is the same, above 1 is worse. Speed: worse, 2.90x; worse, 1.20x; CPU: worse, 1.90x; worse, 1.16x; Memory: worse, 1.22x; better, 0.93x; Findings: differs on 2 of 2; differs on 1 of 1; Windows 11: builds; of the engine and daemon tests, 3 fail at the new version only, 0 at 0.1.5 only; builds; main + six fixes's tests not run on Windows 11; Linux release build: fails to link after 705 s; 0.1.5 builds in 242 s; the new version fails to link; main + six fixes not built this way yet; Upgrade: worse, 1.13x; worse, 8.11x; A hook's cost: worse, 1.13x; worse, 9.96x; Fixes on top: 0.1.5 merges into it with 3 files in conflict; 4 of 6 fixes merge clean
svg.text: Where the new version stands, per question

g.title: worse, 2.90x: 9,295 ms against 3,210 ms: one rule alone (evaluate_ms): typescript-eslint-no-shadow, the typescript pack (65 rules at the new version, 65 at 0.1.5) on real code, 4 cores pinned (one thread per core, RERAIL_THREADS=4), 3 runs a side taken in turn, cold, Linux x64
worse, 1.20x: 1,167 ms against 974 ms: rerail start --repository, answered as set-up answers (a 300-file repository, 382 rules set up), warm store, Linux x64

worse, 1.90x: 33,250 ms against 17,530 ms: CPU time, user and system: the typescript pack (65 rules at the new version, 65 at 0.1.5) on real code, 8 cores pinned (one thread per core, RERAIL_THREADS=8), 3 runs a side taken in turn, cold, Linux x64
worse, 1.16x: 122% of one core against 105% of one core: the daemon's CPU in the 120 s after the first event, a fresh daemon, as after a restart, fresh daemon, Linux x64

worse, 1.22x: 768 MB against 629 MB: peak resident memory: the node pack (37 rules at the new version, 37 at 0.1.5) on real code, 8 cores pinned (one thread per core, RERAIL_THREADS=8), 3 runs a side taken in turn, cold, Linux x64
better, 0.93x: 2,495 MB against 2,691 MB: the daemon's peak resident memory over the run, a fresh daemon, as after a restart, fresh daemon, Linux x64
